name: GXO IKEA Distribution Center - Westampton NJ

fieldNotes.truckGate: The building is ringed by an open perimeter loop road fed from the surrounding Westampton industrial-park street network. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point appears at any property-line connection in z18/z19 satellite or Street View; no perimeter fence. Classed false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No 1-3-vehicle booth at any entrance in z19 satellite or Street View along the perimeter road. Site is open.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate, so no remote check-in inference.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large IKEA DC (~1.09M SF) with continuous dock-door banks running the full length of both the east and west long faces; counted ~130 doors total - solidly in the 50+ band. Exact count approximate; roof solar array does not obscure the dock faces.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run from two physically separate banks on opposite (east and west) building faces, so shipping and receiving operate from separate clusters.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of IKEA trailers parked along both faces, including dedicated drop rows separate from active dock aprons - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide perimeter dock courts on both faces hold queues well over 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in a dense industrial-park / suburban fabric in Westampton NJ (Burlington County, Philadelphia metro); a residential subdivision abuts the north side - Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the building is truck-served only.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide perimeter road and large paved dock courts give ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
